Frequently asked questions

To help you get the information you need quickly, we've compiled a list of frequently asked questions. If you don't find the answer you're looking for, please feel free to contact us directly.

What services does Wugweb offer?

Wugweb offers six core service areas: Strategy, Brand, Experience, Growth, Engineering, and Operations — covering everything from brand positioning and UX design to development, marketing, QA, and automation.

What is the difference between Strategy and Brand services?

Strategy focuses on market positioning, research, and roadmapping — defining where you need to go. Brand brings that strategy to life through visual identity, naming, and guidelines — defining who you are.

What does the Experience service cover?

Experience covers UX/UI design — user research, journey mapping, wireframing, visual design, design systems, and usability testing. It's about creating digital products people love to use.

How do Growth and Engineering differ?

Growth focuses on marketing technology, AI automation, lead generation, and analytics — driving acquisition and retention. Engineering builds the actual digital products — websites, apps, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.

What's included in Operations?

Operations covers QA & testing, no-code development, workflow automation, and site reliability — ensuring your digital products run smoothly, ship faster, and scale without friction.

Do you offer both design and development?

Yes. Our Experience and Brand services cover design, while Engineering handles development. We often combine them for end-to-end projects — from strategy through design to build and launch.

Can I get a custom package combining multiple services?

Absolutely. Most of our engagements combine multiple service areas. We'll work with you to define a scope that fits your specific goals and budget.
